qualification.details: Senior Scientific Officer (DNA): M.Sc. (1st Division) or Ph.D. in Zoology / Physical Anthropology / Genetics / Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Molecular Biology / Forensic Science, or equivalent qualification in any of the above subjects, with Zoology / Botany as one of the subjects at B.Sc. level. Minimum five (05) years' post-qualification hands-on experience of Forensic DNA casework in a State / Central Forensic Science Laboratory, including STR profiling, capillary electrophoresis, mixture interpretation and statistical analysis. Senior Scientific Assistant (DNA): M.Sc. (1st Division) or Ph.D. in Zoology / Physical Anthropology / Genetics / Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Molecular Biology / Forensic Science, or equivalent qualification in any of the above subjects, with Zoology / Botany as one of the subjects at B.Sc. level. Minimum three (03) years' post-qualification hands-on experience of Forensic DNA casework in a State / Central Forensic Science Laboratory, including STR profiling, capillary electrophoresis, mixture interpretation and statistical analysis. Scientific Assistant (DNA): M.Sc. (at least 2nd Division) in Zoology / Physical Anthropology / Genetics / Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Molecular Biology / Forensic Science, or equivalent qualification in any of the above subjects, with Zoology / Botany as one of the subjects at B.Sc. level. Minimum one (01) year's post-qualification experience of Forensic DNA casework in a State / Central Forensic Science Laboratory, including STR profiling, capillary electrophoresis, mixture interpretation and statistical analysis. Lab Attendant (Support Staff, DNA Division): Matriculation (10th) pass from a recognised Board. Prior experience of working as a Laboratory Attendant / Laboratory Assistant in a Government forensic, chemical or pathological laboratory, hospital or educational institution is preferred.

selection_process: Screening on the basis of essential educational qualification and experience Interview before a Selection Committee constituted by the Director

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for FSL Haryana Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.haryanapolice.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Forensic Science Laboratory, Haryana (FSL Haryana), located in Madhuban, Karnal, for filling up contractual scientific and support staff positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies announced across four different posts including Senior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant, Scientific Assistant, and Lab Attendant in the DNA Division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed format and submit it by Registered / Speed Post or in person to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications at the FSL Haryana office is 10 November 2026. Ensure applications reach before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Senior Scientific Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Scientific Officer (DNA) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹ 53,100/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to any of the posts under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Lab Attendant?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Lab Attendant post must have passed Matriculation (10th) from a recognized Board, while 10+2 with Science is considered a desirable preference.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be any written examination?
faq.answer: No, there will be no written examination. Selection will be purely based on the screening of qualifications and experience followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period of one year or until the completion of the existing case pendency of the DNA Division.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with necessary supporting documents should be sent to the Director, Forensic Science Laboratory, Haryana, Madhuban, Karnal - 132 037.
